job_description:
Backend Software Engineer

Role Overview
We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems and APIs. You will work closely with frontend engineers, product, and other stakeholders to build reliable services, improve system performance, and ship production-ready features.

Responsibilities
Design and develop scalable REST APIs and backend services.
Build and maintain backend applications using Node.js and TypeScript/JavaScript.
Design efficient database schemas, queries, indexes, and data models.
Implement authentication, authorization, API security, and access control.
Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability.
Integrate third-party APIs and external services.
Write clean, modular, maintainable, and well-tested code.
Debug production issues and perform root-cause analysis.
Collaborate with frontend engineers to design and integrate APIs.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and system-design decisions.
Deploy and maintain backend services using cloud and DevOps tools.
Required Skills

Programming

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript
Good understanding of Data Structures & Algorithms
Object-oriented and functional programming fundamentals
Writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code

Backend

Node.js
Express.js or similar backend frameworks
REST API design
Authentication & authorization
JWT, sessions, API keys, OAuth fundamentals
Error handling, validation, logging, and middleware

Databases

Strong understanding of SQL
PostgreSQL / MySQL
MongoDB
Database schema design
Indexing and query optimization
Transactions and database relationships

Caching & Distributed Systems

Redis
Caching strategies
Rate limiting
Queues/background jobs
Understanding of concurrency and distributed systems fundamentals

Cloud & DevOps

AWS / GCP / Azure
Docker
CI/CD
Git & GitHub
Linux/command-line fundamentals
Basic understanding of networking and HTTP

Testing & Engineering

Unit and integration testing
API testing with Postman or similar tools
Debugging and profiling
Code reviews and Git workflows
Nice-to-Have Skills
Microservices architecture
Message queues such as Kafka/RabbitMQ
WebSockets
GraphQL
Kubernetes
Infrastructure as Code
System design
Observability tools
AI/LLM API integration and RAG/agentic systems
Ideal Candidate
Strong problem-solving and debugging ability
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment
Takes ownership of features from design → implementation → deployment
Understands trade-offs rather than blindly following patterns
Can learn unfamiliar technologies quickly
Writes code that is simple, reliable, and easy for other engineers to maintain
